Y.AGENT_TEXT, --[20] 23 Y.UD_TEXT, --[21] 24 Y.AGENT, --[22] 25 Y.UD_CODE, --[23] 26 Y.PO_SEQ, --[24] 27 Y.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, --[25] 28 Y.GR_SEQ, --[26] 29 Y.LEGACY_GR_SEQ, --[27] 30 Y.BYCA_COMORG_CODE, --[28] 31 Y.PLANT_CODE, --[29] 32 Y.CONTRACT_NO, --[30] 33 Y.CONTRACT_SEQ, --[31] 34 (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = Y.BUYER) AS BUYER_TEXT, Y.APPEAR_REJT, Y.SIZE_REJT, Y.MATTER_REJT, Y.WEIGHT_REJT, Y.CAPACITY_REJT, Y.DENSITY_REJT, Y.COMPRESSION_REJT, Y.COMPRESSION, Y.DISRUPTION_REJT, Y.DISRUPTION, Y.MOISTURE_REJT, Y.MOISTURE FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM NUM, X.PO_NO, X.LEGACY_PO_NO, X.BUYER_ITEM_NO, X.ITEM_CHECK_NO, X.GR_NO, X.LEGACY_GR_NO, X.RD_DATE, X.GR_DATE, X.ITEM_QTY, X.UNIT_MEASURE, X.PO_CREATE_DATE, X.DESCRIPTION, X.SPECIFICATION, X.APPEAR_VAL, X.SIZE_VAL, X.MATTER_VAL, X.WEIGHT_VAL, X.CAPACITY_VAL, X.DENSITY_VAL, X.COMPRESSION_F, X.DISRUPTION_F, X.MOISTURE_F, X.AGENT_TEXT, X.UD_TEXT, X.AGENT, X.UD_CODE, X.PO_SEQ, X.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, X.GR_SEQ, X.LEGACY_GR_SEQ, X.BYCA_COMORG_CODE, X.PLANT_CODE, X.CONTRACT_NO, X.CONTRACT_SEQ, X.BUYER , X.APPEAR_REJT, X.SIZE_REJT, X.MATTER_REJT, X.WEIGHT_REJT, X.CAPACITY_REJT, X.DENSITY_REJT, X.COMPRESSION_REJT, X.COMPRESSION, X.DISRUPTION_REJT, X.DISRUPTION, X.MOISTURE_REJT, X.MOISTURE
FROM (
SELECT PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, DBEP.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, DBEP.ITEM_CHECK_NO AS ITEM_CHECK_NO, DBEP.GR_NO AS GR_NO, DBEP.LEGACY_GR_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO, PODT.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, GRDT.GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, GRDT.ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY, GRDT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_CREATE_DATE, PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION,

DBEP.APPEAR_REJT AS APPEAR_REJT, DBEP.SIZE_REJT AS SIZE_REJT, DBEP.MATTER_REJT AS MATTER_REJT, DBEP.WEIGHT_REJT AS WEIGHT_REJT, DBEP.CAPACITY_REJT AS CAPACITY_REJT, DBEP.DENSITY_REJT AS DENSITY_REJT, DBEP.COMPRESSION_REJT AS COMPRESSION_REJT, DBEP.COMPRESSION AS COMPRESSION, DBEP.DISRUPTION_REJT AS DISRUPTION_REJT, DBEP.DISRUPTION AS DISRUPTION, DBEP.MOISTURE_REJT AS MOISTURE_REJT, DBEP.MOISTURE AS MOISTURE,
(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = DBEP.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEXT, DECODE(DBEP.UD_CODE,'A','가용','AS','특채','R','보류',' ') AS UD_TEXT,
DBEP.AGENT AS AGENT, DBEP.UD_CODE AS UD_CODE, DBEP.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, DBEP.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, DBEP.GR_SEQ AS GR_SEQ, DBEP.LEGACY_GR_SEQ AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, DBEP.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AS BYCA_COMORG_CODE, DBEP.PLANT_CODE AS PLANT_CODE, DBEP.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, DBEP.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ , GRDT.BUYER
FROM ICOMGRDT GRDT, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, DONGDBEP DBEP WHERE GRDT.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND GRDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND GRDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND GRDT.PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND GRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND GRDT.BUYER = DBEP.BUYER AND GRDT.PO_NO = DBEP.PO_NO AND GRDT.PO_SEQ = DBEP.PO_SEQ AND GRDT.GR_NO = DBEP.GR_NO AND GRDT.GR_SEQ = DBEP.GR_SEQ AND DBEP.PLANT_CODE IN ('2210','2220','5210') AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D'
AND POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND GRDT.GR_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND DBEP.UD_CODE = #{st_ud_code}
AND (DBEP.PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no} || '%' OR DBEP.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no} || '%')
AND DBEP.AGENT = #{st_agent}
AND (PODT.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%' OR PODT.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%')
AND DBEP.ITEM_CHECK_NO LIKE #{st_item_check_no} || '%'
AND DBEP.APPEAR_VAL = 'R'
AND DBEP.SIZE_VAL = 'R'
AND DBEP.MATTER_VAL = 'R'
AND DBEP.WEIGHT_VAL = 'R'
AND DBEP.CAPACITY_VAL = 'R'
AND DBEP.DENSITY_VAL = 'R'
AND DBEP.COMPRESSION_F = 'R'
AND DBEP.DISRUPTION_F = 'R'
AND DBEP.MOISTURE_F = 'R'
ORDER BY DBEP.CHANGE_DATE DESC ) X ) Y

AND DBEP.UD_CODE = #{st_ud_code}

AND DBEP.MOISTURE_F = 'R'
AND PODT.RD_DATE >= GRDT.GR_DATE GROUP BY DBEP.AGENT) X, ( SELECT DBEP.AGENT AS AGENT, COUNT(DISTINCT DBEP.BYCA_COMORG_CODE|| DBEP.BUYER|| DBEP.PLANT_CODE|| DBEP.LEGACY_PO_NO|| DBEP.LEGACY_PO_SEQ|| DBEP.PO_NO|| DBEP.PO_SEQ|| DBEP.LEGACY_GR_NO|| DBEP.LEGACY_GR_SEQ|| DBEP.GR_NO|| DBEP.GR_SEQ) AS CNT
FROM ICOMGRDT GRDT, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, DONGDBEP DBEP WHERE GRDT.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND GRDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND GRDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND GRDT.PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND GRDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND GRDT.BUYER = DBEP.BUYER AND GRDT.PO_NO = DBEP.PO_NO AND GRDT.PO_SEQ = DBEP.PO_SEQ AND GRDT.GR_NO = DBEP.GR_NO AND GRDT.GR_SEQ = DBEP.GR_SEQ AND DBEP.PLANT_CODE IN ('2210','2220','5210') AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D'
AND POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND GRDT.GR_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND DBEP.UD_CODE = #{st_ud_code}
AND (DBEP.PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no} || '%' OR DBEP.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no} || '%')
AND DBEP.AGENT = #{st_agent}
AND (PODT.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%' OR PODT.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%')
AND DBEP.ITEM_CHECK_NO LIKE #{st_item_check_no} || '%'
AND DBEP.APPEAR_VAL = 'R'

AND DBEP.MATTER_VAL = 'R'
AND DBEP.WEIGHT_VAL = 'R'
AND DBEP.CAPACITY_VAL = 'R'
AND DBEP.DENSITY_VAL = 'R'

mapper.update: INSERT INTO KEPQTDT ( BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION, AGENT, AGENT_REVISION, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, ATOS_DATE, ATOS_END_DATE, ATOS_END_TIME, ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, DSS_FLAG, DSS_CHOICE ) ( SELECT #{BUYER}, /* 1 : BUYER */ #{QUOTATION_NO}, /* 2 : QUOTATION_NO */ #{QUOTATION_SEQ}, /* 3 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ #{REVISION}, /* 4 : REVISION */ #{AGENT}, /* 5 : AGENT */ #{AGENT_REVISION}, /* 6 : AGENT_REVISION */ 'C', BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_CODE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')AS ATOS_DATE, #{ATOS_END_DATE}, /* 7 : ATOS_END_DATE */ #{ATOS_END_TIME}, /* 8 : ATOS_END_TIME */ ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, #{DSS_FLAG}, /* 9 : DSS_FLAG if(chk_str[1].equals("A") || chk_str[1].equals("B") || chk_str[1].equals("C")|| chk_str[1].equals("S")) : Y , 기타 : N */ #{DSS_CHOICE} /* 10 : DSS_CHOICE */ FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER=#{BUYER} /* 11 : BUYER */ AND QUOTATION_NO=#{QUOTATION_NO} /* 12 : QUOTATION_NO */ AND QUOTATION_SEQ=#{QUOTATION_SEQ} /* 13 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ AND REVISION=#{REVISION} /* 14 : REVISION */ AND RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND STATUS IN ('C','R') )

UPDATE KEPRQDT SET RECV_FLAG = 'GD' , CANCEL_USER_ID = #{USR_ID} /*CANCEL_USER_ID*/ , CANCEL_DATE = SYSDATE , CANCEL_REMARK = #{CANCEL_REMARK} /*CANCEL_REMARK*/ WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} /*BUYER*/ AND QUOTATION_NO = #{QUOTATION_NO} /*QUOTATION_NO*/ AND QUOTATION_SEQ = #{QUOTATION_SEQ} /*QUOTATION_SEQ*/ AND REVISION = #{REVISION} /*REVISION*/ AND STATUS IN ('C','R')
